details:
The gfs2-utils packages contain utilities for creating, checking, modifying, and correcting any inconsistencies in GFS2 global file systems.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * gfs2-utils: gfs2-utils: stack out-of-bounds write via unchecked height in savemeta (CVE-2026-71221)
  * gfs2-utils: gfs2-utils: stack out-of-bounds write via unchecked di_height in gfs2_edit (CVE-2026-71220)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
